substitutionPolicy: Automated graph counts, route explorers, unit tests and scripted smoke runs may check reachability but cannot substitute for blind human observations or acceptance.

blindSetup: Give the reader only the current build and neutral task instructions; do not explain intended route, canon or correct choice.
Use a fresh save for each route/final/outcome leg; record build SHA and locale before starting.
Do not coach a reader toward a route or repair a confusing state during the observation.
Collect immediate comprehension and emotional-response notes before debriefing the reader.
requiredEvidencePerLeg: route target or natural choice path

follow through to both Leo finals where assigned

follow through to Nika own-way final

checks: romance is not used to erase business boundary
goodbye is not punitive or coerced
history can remain true without becoming future
numbers, staff voices and public terms are understood as causal prerequisites
control and staff protections remain visible
outcome is distinct without erasing staff contribution

stateAndContinuityLegs: EP2 agreement closes on day 9; EP4 fresh public consent is not inferred from prior agreement.
EP6 is the sole route lock; earlier flirtation or business choices must not silently lock a route.
Back/new-game/load and locale switching do not leak route, consent or hotel state.
Four routes retain distinct character voice, knowledge, promises and business causality through EP10.
Tempo is checked at EP2 boundary, EP3 reveal, EP6 route lock, EP9 public forum and EP10 resolution.

comprehension: What changed because of your choices?
When did you believe the route became distinct?
What did you think the hotel outcome depended on?
continuity: Did any character know or assume something too early?
Did any consent or business boundary feel carried forward without a new choice?
characterAndRelationship: Were the four route voices distinguishable?
Did affection and work consequences remain separate where intended?
Did each final feel earned rather than arbitrary?
pace: Where did attention dip or rush?
Which transition or reveal needed more/less time?
qualityOfFinals: Did all seven relationship finals feel meaningfully different?
Did the three hotel outcomes feel causally distinct and emotionally fair?
readerQuestionnaire.severity: Record P0/P1 player-blocking defects separately from P2/P3 preference or cosmetic comments; do not start an endless cosmetic rewrite cycle.

passRequires: no unresolved P0/P1 continuity or save-state defect
reader notes independently corroborate comprehension and distinctness
